Title: Payment fails for Visa cards issued in Europe
Description: Users with Visa cards issued by European banks see 'Transaction declined' on checkout. Reproduces 100% on staging with test card 4000-0000-0000-3220.
Comments: Investigated by Priya: gateway returns error code 51 for these BINs. Issue is on Stripe radar rules. Mihir confirmed our radar config blocks high-risk regions too aggressively.
Resolution: Updated Stripe Radar rules to allowlist verified EU BINs. Added integration test covering EU card scenarios.

Title: PayPal redirect returns to wrong page after checkout
Description: After completing PayPal checkout users are redirected to /home instead of /order/confirmation. Order is created correctly but user thinks payment failed and retries.
Comments: Root cause: return_url was set to '/' due to env var fallback. Confirmed in staging logs.
Resolution: Fixed env var PAYPAL_RETURN_URL in all environments. Added smoke test that verifies redirect target.

Title: Currency conversion shows wrong total on international orders
Description: Cart total in INR displays 86.5x USD value but checkout charges based on a stale rate from previous day. Customers complaining about being overcharged by ~2%.
Comments: Exchange rate cache TTL was 24h. Should be 1h max. Also discovered we were not invalidating on rate updates from forex API webhook.
Resolution: Reduced cache TTL to 1 hour and wired up webhook invalidation. Added monitoring alert if displayed rate differs from charged rate by >0.5%.

Title: Credit card 3D Secure flow times out on slow networks
Description: 3DS verification iframe loads but never returns control to checkout page. Users on 3G/spotty wifi see infinite spinner. Happens ~5% of mobile checkouts.
Comments: Confirmed iframe postMessage was being blocked by our CSP frame-ancestors directive after the redirect. Only manifests when 3DS challenge takes >8s.
Resolution: Updated CSP to allowlist 3DS provider domains. Added timeout fallback that shows manual continue button after 15s.

Title: Users cannot log in via SSO when their company email changes
Description: After IT changes a user's email via Azure AD, SSO login fails with 'user not found' even though the user exists with the new email.
Comments: We were keying users on email instead of SSO subject ID. Classic mistake. Found 47 affected users in last 6 months by querying audit logs.
Resolution: Migrated user lookup to use SSO 'sub' claim. Added a one-time migration for affected users. Documented the lookup contract.

Title: Login button unresponsive on Safari 15 and earlier
Description: Click handler on the login button does nothing on Safari 15. Works fine on Safari 16+ and all other browsers. About 3% of our users still on Safari 15.
Comments: Issue traced to optional chaining in a vendored polyfill that Safari 15 doesn't fully support in that context. The button was never bound.
Resolution: Added a Babel transform target for Safari 15. Removed the problematic optional chain.

Title: Session expires too quickly on mobile web
Description: Users on mobile browsers get logged out after ~10 minutes of inactivity even though session TTL is 24h. Desktop is unaffected.
Comments: Cookie SameSite=Strict combined with how Safari handles cross-site context on iframe-embedded pages caused cookie to be dropped. Confirmed via cookie inspection on real device.
Resolution: Switched session cookie to SameSite=Lax. Added e2e test simulating mobile context.

Title: Password reset email never arrives for Gmail users
Description: Some Gmail recipients never receive password reset emails. SendGrid says delivered but Gmail bounce report shows soft rejection due to SPF misalignment.
Comments: Our SPF record was missing the new sending IP added during SendGrid migration. Anything from that IP got soft-rejected.
Resolution: Updated SPF record to include all SendGrid IP ranges. Set up DMARC reporting to catch this earlier next time.

Title: Worker service memory leak when processing PDF attachments
Description: Memory usage of worker pods climbs from 200MB to 4GB over ~6 hours then OOMs. Correlates with PDF processing volume. Started after we shipped PDF preview generation.
Comments: Leak isolated to pdf-lib library: we were creating Document instances per request but not explicitly disposing. Confirmed via heap dump diff.
Resolution: Wrapped PDF processing in try/finally with explicit doc.unload(). Added pod memory alert at 80%. Switched to streaming approach for files >10MB.

Title: API response times degrade after 3 hours of uptime
Description: P99 latency on /api/search climbs from 200ms to 2s+ after pods have been running ~3 hours. Restart fixes it temporarily.
Comments: Found a Redis connection pool that was leaking sockets due to missed pool.release() in error path. Sockets piled up in TIME_WAIT.
Resolution: Added pool.release in finally block. Reviewed all other Redis usages for similar pattern. Added connection pool size monitoring.

Title: Background job queue grows unbounded during high load
Description: During Monday morning traffic spikes the job queue grows from baseline ~50 to 20k+ and never recovers without manual intervention.
Comments: Worker count was static at 4 regardless of load. Also discovered one job type was taking 30s due to a missing DB index on jobs.created_at.
Resolution: Added autoscaling based on queue depth. Added the missing index. Set up SLO alert if queue depth exceeds threshold for >5min.

Title: Dashboard widgets slow to load when account has >1000 items
Description: Customer with ~3000 items reports dashboard takes 25s to load. Profiling shows N+1 queries on widget data fetch.
Comments: Standard N+1 issue: each widget was firing its own query per item instead of batching. ~3000 queries per page load.
Resolution: Refactored to single batched query per widget. Added query count assertion in tests. Page now loads in 1.2s for the same account.

Title: CSV export missing last row of data
Description: Exporting reports as CSV consistently drops the final row. Discovered by finance team during month-end reconciliation.
Comments: Off-by-one in our stream-to-csv writer. We were flushing the writer one row early because of a flawed end-of-iterator check.
Resolution: Fixed the iterator loop. Added a test that exports exactly N rows and asserts the count.

Title: Excel export corrupts Unicode characters in names
Description: Names with non-ASCII characters (Hindi, Chinese, accented Latin) show up as garbled in Excel even though CSV opens fine.
Comments: Excel expects UTF-8 BOM to autodetect encoding. We were emitting UTF-8 without BOM.
Resolution: Added BOM prefix to .xlsx exports. Documented this in our export module README so the next dev doesn't repeat it.

Title: Large PDF exports time out for accounts with >500 invoices
Description: PDF export endpoint times out at 30s for large accounts. User has no way to download their invoices.
Comments: Synchronous PDF generation simply can't fit in HTTP timeout for that volume. Need async approach.
Resolution: Moved large exports to background job + email delivery. Show 'we will email you' message instead of inline download for >100 rows.

Title: Date picker broken on Safari iOS
Description: Date picker on /reports page shows blank picker on iPhone Safari. Users cannot filter by date range from mobile.
Comments: Library we use does not support iOS-native date input properly. Has been a known issue in the upstream repo for 8 months.
Resolution: Replaced the date picker library with a Safari-compatible alternative. Added Browserstack test on iOS Safari.

Title: Drag-and-drop file upload does not work in Firefox
Description: Dragging a file onto the upload zone does nothing in Firefox. Works in Chrome and Edge. Click-to-upload still works as fallback.
Comments: Missing dragover preventDefault. Classic.
Resolution: Added the preventDefault. Tested across Chrome/Firefox/Safari/Edge.

Title: Chrome autofill conflicts with form validation
Description: Chrome autofills the signup form but our validation flags the autofilled values as empty until user clicks into a field. Causes signup drop-off.
Comments: Our validation reads from React state which never gets updated when Chrome autofills directly into the DOM input.
Resolution: Added input event listener that syncs DOM value back to React state. Documented this gotcha in our form component README.

Title: Email notifications sent twice for the same event
Description: Customers receiving duplicate notification emails. Customer success flagged 12 complaints in a week.
Comments: Notification consumer was missing idempotency. A retry on transient SendGrid 503 caused duplicate dispatches.
Resolution: Added an idempotency key (event_id + recipient) with a 24h dedup window in Redis. Replayed last 7 days of events to confirm no further dupes.

Title: Push notifications missing on Android 13
Description: Push notifications silently fail on Android 13 devices. No error thrown. Users assume notifications are off.
Comments: Android 13 requires runtime permission for POST_NOTIFICATIONS. Our app was using AndroidManifest declaration only which worked on Android 12 but not 13.
Resolution: Added runtime permission request on first launch. Added a settings page row to re-prompt if denied.

Title: Slack integration drops attachments larger than 5MB
Description: Files >5MB sent via the Slack integration are silently dropped. The message goes through but the file does not.
Comments: Slack's files.upload API uses a different endpoint than chat.postMessage and we were not using it for larger files. Our chat.postMessage approach uploads up to 5MB.
Resolution: Added size-based routing: <5MB uses chat.postMessage, larger files use files.upload v2. Tested with 50MB file successfully.

Title: Search returns no results for queries with special characters
Description: Searching for 'O'Brien' or 'foo&bar' returns zero results even when those records exist.
Comments: Our query builder was sanitizing apostrophes and ampersands too aggressively, stripping them entirely instead of escaping for the search backend.
Resolution: Fixed query sanitization to properly escape rather than strip. Added test cases for common special chars.

Title: Mobile app crashes on launch after iOS 17 update
Description: Users report app crashes immediately on launch after updating to iOS 17. Affects ~8% of iOS users so far.
Comments: Crash log points to a deprecated UIScene API we were using during launch. Apple removed it in iOS 17.
Resolution: Migrated to the new UIScene lifecycle API. Released hotfix v4.2.1 within 48 hours.

Title: Refund fails silently for partial refunds over $500
Description: When a support agent issues a partial refund above $500, the API returns 200 but no refund is actually created in the payment processor.
Comments: Priya: Confirmed in prod logs — Stripe webhook for refund.created never fires for these. || Support flagged 4 customers affected this week.

Title: MFA codes not delivered via SMS for +44 numbers
Description: Users with UK phone numbers report never receiving their 6-digit MFA code, blocking login entirely.
Comments: Dev: Looks like our SMS provider is silently dropping messages to a subset of UK carriers. Escalated to vendor.

Title: Rate limiter blocks legitimate traffic during traffic spikes
Description: During flash-sale traffic spikes, the API gateway rate limiter starts rejecting legitimate requests from paying customers, not just abusive ones.
Comments: Backend: Threshold is per-IP, and enterprise customers behind shared NAT are getting caught. Fix drafted, in review.

Title: Checkout button disabled state persists after network retry
Description: If a checkout request times out and the frontend retries, the Place Order button stays disabled even after the retry succeeds.
Comments: QA: Reproduced on slow 3G throttling. Root cause was a stale loading flag not being reset on retry.
Resolution: Fixed the retry handler to reset the button's disabled state on both success and failure paths.

Title: Scheduled report emails stop after account timezone change
Description: When an admin changes their account's timezone setting, previously-scheduled weekly report emails silently stop sending.
Comments: Reports team: cron scheduling logic re-computes next-run time using a stale timezone cache.

Title: In-app notification badge count never resets to zero
Description: After a user reads all their notifications, the unread badge count in the top nav still shows a stale number.
Comments: Frontend: badge count was reading from a cached Redux slice that wasn't invalidated on mark-as-read.
Resolution: Invalidate the notifications cache slice whenever mark-as-read fires; badge now updates immediately.

Title: Autocomplete suggestions lag by 2+ seconds on large catalogs
Description: For accounts with 10,000+ SKUs, the search autocomplete dropdown takes over two seconds to populate, making it feel broken.
Comments: Search: current implementation queries the full index on every keystroke instead of debouncing.

Title: Android app freezes when rotating device during video upload
Description: Rotating the device mid-upload on Android causes the upload progress screen to freeze, sometimes losing the upload entirely.
Comments: Mobile: activity is being recreated on rotation and losing the upload task reference. Needs a retained fragment or ViewModel fix.

Title: Dashboard initial load exceeds 8s for accounts with 50+ users
Description: Large team accounts see the main dashboard take 8-10 seconds to become interactive, well above the 2s target.
Comments: Perf: N+1 query fetching per-user activity stats was the main culprit.
Resolution: Batched the per-user activity query into a single join; load time down to ~1.8s for large accounts.

Title: Zapier webhook retries create duplicate downstream records
Description: When our Zapier webhook delivery fails and Zapier auto-retries, some customers end up with duplicate records created in their downstream tools.
Comments: Integrations: we don't send an idempotency key on webhook payloads, so retries aren't deduped on our side or theirs.

Title: Invoice PDF shows tax total in wrong currency for EU accounts
Description: EU accounts billed in EUR sometimes see their invoice PDF's tax line item rendered in USD while the rest of the invoice is correctly in EUR.
Comments: Payments: PDF template pulls tax amount from a different service call than the rest of the totals, and that call defaults to USD.

Title: Account lockout after 3 failed attempts doesn't reset after 30 min as documented
Description: Docs say a locked account should auto-unlock after 30 minutes, but users report still being locked out hours later.
Comments: Auth: the unlock timer was using the wrong Redis TTL unit (seconds vs. milliseconds), so it was effectively 30000 minutes.
Resolution: Corrected the TTL unit; lockouts now correctly expire after 30 minutes.

Title: Nightly reconciliation job silently skips records with null customer_id
Description: The nightly billing reconciliation job is supposed to flag mismatches for manual review, but records with a null customer_id are silently dropped instead of flagged, hiding real discrepancies.
Comments: Backend: this has been silently happening for at least 3 weeks based on job logs — could mean unreconciled revenue.

Title: Settings page loses unsaved changes on tab switch
Description: If a user edits their settings and switches browser tabs before saving, their changes are lost on return with no warning.
Comments: Frontend: no beforeunload / visibility change guard currently implemented for the settings form.

Title: Webhook notification signature validation fails intermittently
Description: Customers report our outbound webhook signature occasionally fails their HMAC validation, causing them to reject valid events.
Comments: Notifications: found a race condition where the payload was serialized after signing under high load, causing a mismatch.
Resolution: Moved signature generation to happen after final payload serialization; validated with load test.

Title: Currency symbol missing on invoice summary for JPY accounts
Description: JPY-billed accounts see a bare number on the invoice summary line instead of the ¥ symbol.
Comments: Payments: cosmetic only, totals are correct, just missing the symbol prefix in one template.

Title: Password strength meter doesn't update on paste
Description: The password strength indicator only updates on keystroke events, so pasting a password leaves it stuck showing 'weak'.
Comments: Frontend: needs an input event listener instead of keyup.
Resolution: Switched to the input event so paste, autofill, and typing all trigger a re-evaluation.

Title: Cache invalidation delayed by up to 60s after config update
Description: Admin config changes (e.g. feature flags) can take up to 60 seconds to propagate due to cache TTL, causing confusing 'it's not working' reports right after a change.
Comments: Backend: expected given current TTL design, but worth shortening or adding a manual purge button.

Title: Export filename doesn't include date range when custom range selected
Description: CSV exports with a custom date range download as 'export.csv' instead of including the selected range in the filename.
Comments: Reports: minor UX papercut, several users have asked for it in feedback.

Title: Tooltip text overflows container on narrow viewports
Description: On viewports under 380px wide, tooltip text overflows its container instead of wrapping.
Comments: Frontend: missing a max-width and white-space: normal on the tooltip component.
Resolution: Added max-width and text wrapping to the shared tooltip component.

Title: Digest email subject line truncates long account names
Description: Accounts with long display names get a subject line that cuts off mid-word in the weekly digest email.
Comments: Notifications: subject line template needs an ellipsis truncation helper instead of a hard character cut.

Title: Search result highlighting misses partial word matches
Description: Searching 'checkout' highlights the full word in results but doesn't highlight it within 'checkout-flow' or similar compound terms.
Comments: Search: highlighting regex is doing exact word-boundary matching only.

Title: iOS app icon badge doesn't clear after reading all notifications
Description: The home screen app icon badge count on iOS sometimes stays at a stale number even after all in-app notifications are read.
Comments: Mobile: badge count wasn't being reset via the push notification service when read state changed locally.
Resolution: Added a badge-clear call to APNs whenever local read state reaches zero unread.

Title: Memory usage climbs slowly during long report-generation sessions
Description: Generating many large reports back-to-back in one session causes browser memory usage to climb steadily rather than being released between reports.
Comments: Perf: suspect a detached DOM node leak from the report preview component not being fully unmounted.

Title: Slack message formatting loses bold/italic on long messages
Description: Slack notifications over ~500 characters lose their bold/italic markdown formatting, posting as plain text instead.
Comments: Integrations: likely hitting a formatting-strip fallback meant for a different edge case.

Title: Refund processing fails for orders paid via Apple Pay
Description: Refunds initiated for orders originally paid with Apple Pay fail with a generic error, while card-paid refunds work fine.
Comments: Payments: Apple Pay tokens require a different refund endpoint that wasn't wired up.
Resolution: Routed Apple Pay refunds through the correct token-based refund endpoint.

Title: OAuth token refresh fails silently after 24 hours
Description: Users connected via OAuth get silently logged out after exactly 24 hours because the refresh token exchange fails without surfacing an error.
Comments: Auth: refresh token expiry was misconfigured to match access token expiry instead of being longer-lived.
Resolution: Extended refresh token TTL and added error surfacing when refresh fails.

Title: Database connection pool exhausted during batch import
Description: Large batch imports (10k+ rows) exhaust the DB connection pool, causing unrelated requests across the app to start timing out.
Comments: Backend: import job wasn't releasing connections between chunks, holding them for the full job duration.
Resolution: Refactored the import job to release and reacquire connections per chunk instead of holding one for the whole run.

Title: Weekly summary report double-counts events near midnight UTC
Description: Events that occur within a few minutes of midnight UTC sometimes get counted in both the current and next weekly report.
Comments: Reports: off-by-one in the date range boundary query, using >= on both ends instead of a half-open interval.
Resolution: Fixed the boundary query to use a proper half-open date range.

Title: Modal dialog traps focus incorrectly, breaks keyboard navigation
Description: Tabbing through a modal dialog occasionally lets focus escape to elements behind the modal, breaking keyboard-only navigation.
Comments: Frontend: focus trap wasn't accounting for dynamically-rendered elements added after the modal opened.
Resolution: Rebuilt the focus trap to recompute focusable elements on each Tab keypress instead of only on mount.

Title: SMS notifications not sent for accounts outside US/Canada
Description: Accounts with phone numbers outside US/Canada never receive SMS notifications, with no error surfaced anywhere.
Comments: Notifications: SMS provider integration was hardcoded to a US/Canada-only sending profile.
Resolution: Switched to the provider's international sending profile and added delivery status logging.

Title: Filters reset unexpectedly when navigating back from bug detail
Description: Applying filters on the bug list, opening a bug, then hitting browser back clears all previously-applied filters.
Comments: Search/Frontend: filter state lived in component state instead of the URL, so it didn't survive navigation.
Resolution: Moved filter state into URL query params so back navigation restores it correctly.

Title: Push notification deep link opens wrong screen on cold start
Description: Tapping a push notification when the app is fully closed (cold start) sometimes opens the home screen instead of the intended deep-linked screen.
Comments: Mobile: deep link intent was being processed before the navigation stack finished initializing on cold start.
Resolution: Deferred deep link handling until the navigation stack signals it's ready.

Title: Search indexing job causes CPU spikes affecting API latency
Description: The nightly search re-indexing job causes CPU spikes severe enough to visibly slow down unrelated API requests during the run window.
Comments: Perf: indexing job wasn't rate-limited or given a lower scheduling priority relative to request-serving processes.
Resolution: Moved indexing to a separate worker pool with a CPU cap, isolated from request-serving processes.

Title: Google Sheets export drops rows with formulas
Description: Exporting to Google Sheets silently drops any row that originally contained a spreadsheet formula rather than a static value.
Comments: Integrations: export step was filtering out cells it couldn't parse as plain values instead of exporting them as text.
Resolution: Formula cells now export as their last-computed value instead of being dropped.

Title: Subscription downgrade doesn't prorate remaining days
Description: Downgrading mid-cycle charges the new lower rate for the next full cycle without crediting the unused portion of the higher-tier cycle.
Comments: Payments: proration logic only existed for upgrades, not downgrades.
Resolution: Extended the existing proration logic to handle downgrades symmetrically with upgrades.

Title: Biometric login fails after app update on Android 14
Description: Users on Android 14 who update the app report Face/Fingerprint login failing every time post-update, forcing a password fallback.
Comments: Mobile: Android 14 changed biometric prompt API behavior; our cached credential handle became invalid after update.
Resolution: Re-enrolled biometric credential handle on first launch after an app update on Android 14+.
